unsupported: Carolina Chain & Cable, LLC operates from Aberdeen, North Carolina, as a division of ALP Industries, which was founded in 1981 by Reitzel Swaim and Ron Space in Parkesburg, Pennsylvania.

The company distributes and sells a range of industrial lifting products, including wire rope, chain, load binders, and below‑the‑hook devices under proprietary trademarks such as Penco®, Saf‑T‑Grip®, Grip‑Tite®, Redi‑Grip®, Mulox®, and Tufskin®.
Customers span industries that rely on lifting and rigging equipment, such as construction, manufacturing, utilities, and transportation.
The company’s product mission emphasizes safety and customer satisfaction, supplying both standard and custom rigging solutions to end users and distributors alike.
note: Source describes ALP Industries, not Carolina Chain & Cable, LLC.
